product_definition.definition: Full directional support width centered on actual wind_direction, with uniform weights inside the support and normalization preserving total energy of the existing radial spectrum; not half-angle or standard deviation.
product_definition.zero: Exact ideal single direction; 360 means uniform all directions. No unapproved epsilon for the zero endpoint.
product_definition.scope: Direction distribution only; preserve radial spectrum, wave-height basis, seed and spectrum type. Native dirbias requires a proven exact conversion, otherwise a legal owned directional-spectrum graph.
required_basis: existing radial spectrum, type and total energy
capture_blockers: versioned spectrum formula, directional weights and exact endpoint representability
parameter-to-spectrum consumption and editable angular-spectrum ports; no linear bias conversion or silent spectrum switch

common_rules.units: Lengths use current scene units (SU), velocities SU/s; read actual FPS and time scale. No SI conversion without explicit scale and mass bases.
common_rules.validation: Require finite values and each control's zero policy; reject unsigned negatives, missing bases, incompatible combinations and budget excess. No clamping, rounding, implicit conversion or renaming.
common_rules.randomness: Use fixed task seed, stable entity IDs and independent control sub-seeds; reopening reproduces samples and changing one control does not resample another. New percentages are bounded amplitudes, not statistical variance.
common_rules.basis: Freeze bases, coordinate spaces, distributions, time scales and controlled stages. Missing axes, targets, events, source geometry or stable IDs remain explicit missing inputs; preserve unrelated artist fields.
common_rules.ranges: Preserve existing names and validation ranges. Mathematical conditions, version-specific native hard limits, product limits and scene budgets remain distinct; unsupported endpoints stay blocked. Range, alias or endpoint changes require a specific decision.
common_rules.readback: Observe actual parameters, attributes, channels, topology or semantic programs and their input SHA, not requested values. Cache/render authorization, 12-frame/120-second limits and total disk budget remain required; product approval does not authorize real jobs.
common_rules.existing_definitions: Preserve particle life/velocity variance, Crowd path_variance and Geometry scale_variance; preserve the existing RBD activation_frame constant active step.

common_capture_requirements.interface: For each version, capture raw definition/help/SDK sources and hashes, exact operators/machine parameters, types/tuples, menu tokens, defaults/expressions, hard/soft ranges, disable/hide state, indexed input/output roles, editable boundaries and downstream consumption.
common_capture_requirements.attributes: Attribute routes additionally need class/storage/tuple, coordinate space, stable IDs and actual downstream consumption rules; labels, help anchors, sliders and other-version tokens are not machine interface proof.
common_capture_requirements.runtime: Static evidence bounds pure contracts/native API substitutes. Instance state, geometry/fields, save/reopen and dynamic effects require separately authorized real-host evidence. Recovered JSON excerpts do not replace missing original HDA bytes.
